# Intentional Mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/IntentionalMode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The abstract category of intrinsic intentional moments — desires and intentions — that inhere in exactly one agent and aim at a goal. The intrinsic branch of [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md), and the conative member of the kernel [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md) family (alongside cognition's [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) and epistemics' doxastic states) so an agent's whole mental life is queryable as one family ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)) — [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md) ⊑ [gufo:IntrinsicMode](../../external/terms.md#gufo-intrinsicmode) supplies the [gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) branch. Never instantiated directly: instances are Desires or Intentions (the commitment-graded trichotomy; the social grade is [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md), a relator, not a mode).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md), [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md), [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md), [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the domain for what is shared by the intrinsic branch — single-bearer inherence via [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) and intention-tenure — and to query desires and intentions together without the social grade.

### Avoid when

- Avoid instantiating it directly (mint a [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) or [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md)) and avoid using it for socially-committed cases — committed TOWARD another agent is [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md), a relator, not a mode.

### How to use

- Type the moment as [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) or [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) and let it inherit [`IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md); the single bearer is [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) (functional), and adoption over time is reified as [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md).

### Examples

- ex:wishForRain a [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md); [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) ex:lillith. # an [`IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) by inheritance
